source: WWE SmackDown vs Raw 2009 (DS): shared 26-joint rig, measured from 34 wrestler models + 50 create-a-wrestler body parts. Numbers only; no meshes or textures are copied.
unit: fraction of standing height (head top to sole)
notes: Everyone shares one skeleton; size differences come from a per-character scale at runtime plus mesh bulk.
Legs are half the height; arm span equals height; about 7 heads tall (heroic proportions).
Body bulk (front-to-back depth) varies about 1.5x between the leanest and heaviest wrestlers.
